sentences.zh: 但你谈论了很多关于亿万富翁的事情。

sentences.en: And so I think these corrupt tariffs that are raising prices in the checkout line are top of mind.
sentences.zh: 在这场竞选中，你会做什么？关于改变那个系统，什么引起了共鸣？

sentences.en: I think this new corrupt war in the Middle East that is driving up gas and diesel prices at the pump is top of mind.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，世界上最富有的人和他的超级政治行动委员会（Super PACs）花费2亿美元来击败我，是因为他们知道我不接受企业政治行动委员会的钱，从来没有，也永远不会。

sentences.en: I've said before that we have an affordability crisis because we have a corruption crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们知道我主张系统性的政治改革，禁止企业政治行动委员会和超级政治行动委员会，这样亿万富翁就不能买断我们的选举；禁止国会议员在任职期间交易股票和中饱私囊；推翻“联合公民案”裁决，把这些大钱从我们的政治中剔除出去。

sentences.en: And so I think these recent developments, I think, are the kind of the straw that broke the camel's back.
sentences.zh: 我还主张在联邦的每个州——无论是红州还是蓝州——禁止杰利蝾螈（不公正划分选区），这样我们才能再次拥有自由和公正的选举。

sentences.en: People's wages have been stagnant for five decades now.
sentences.zh: 我还谈到了任期限制。

sentences.en: Work has not been rewarded.
sentences.zh: 我已经承诺在美国参议院只担任两届任期，我想让这对每一位参议员都适用。

sentences.en: And now these recent price spikes have left people across the political spectrum fed up
sentences.zh: 我想让这对每一位国会议员都适用，他们来这里是为了服务，然后他们应该为其他人提供服务的机会。

sentences.en: and they are ready for change, not incremental change, but wholesale change and systemic change.
sentences.zh: 这些是我认为可以重建一个“民有、民治、民享”的政府的系统性改革，而不是我们现在拥有的这个由亿万富翁所有、治理和享有的政府。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about specifically what you would do about that, the wholesale change that
sentences.zh: 这些目标很宏大，看起来像是长期的政治改革计划。

sentences.en: you are talking a lot about that is appealing to a fair number of Republican voters and Democratic voters.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你对一些非常具体、现实且短期的东西——比如汽油价格——有什么应对方法。

sentences.en: But you're talking a lot about billionaires.
sentences.zh: 你打算如何降低汽油价格？

sentences.en: What would you do in this campaign and what has been resonating about changing that system?
sentences.zh: 在这场竞选中你会怎么做？关于改变那个体制，什么内容引起了共鸣？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the reason the richest man in the world and his super PACs are spending $200 million
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，全球首富和他的超级政治行动委员会之所以花费两亿美元

sentences.en: to defeat me is because they know I don't take corporate PAC money, never have, never will.
sentences.zh: 来击败我，是因为他们知道我不接受企业政治行动委员会的资金，过去没有，将来也不会。

sentences.en: And they know that I'm running on systemic political reform, banning corporate PACs and
sentences.zh: 他们知道我主张进行系统性的政治改革，禁止企业政治行动委员会和

sentences.en: super PACs so billionaires can't buy our elections, banning members of Congress from trading stocks
sentences.zh: 超级政治行动委员会，这样亿万富翁就无法操纵我们的选举；禁止国会议员交易股票

sentences.en: and enriching themselves while they're in office, overturning Citizens United and getting this big money out of our politics.
sentences.zh: 并在任职期间中饱私囊；推翻“联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案”的裁决，将这些巨额资金从我们的政治中剔除。

sentences.en: I'm also running on banning gerrymandering in every state in the union, red states and blue states alike, so we can have free and fair elections again.
sentences.zh: 我还主张在全美每一个州，无论是红州还是蓝州，都禁止选区划分不公，这样我们才能再次拥有自由公正的选举。

sentences.en: And I'm also talking about term limits.
sentences.zh: 此外，我还谈到了任期限制。

sentences.en: I've already pledged to only serve two terms in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我已经承诺在美国参议院只担任两届任期，

sentences.en: Senate, and I want to make that true for every senator.
sentences.zh: 我希望每一位参议员都能如此。

sentences.en: I want to make that true for every member of Congress that they are in this to serve and then they should make room for someone else to have the opportunity to serve.
sentences.zh: 我希望每一位国会议员都能如此，他们来这里是为了服务，之后就应该腾出位置，让其他人也有机会服务。

sentences.en: These are the kind of systemic reforms that I think could rebuild a government of by and for the people instead of what we have now, which is a government
sentences.zh: 我认为这些系统性改革能够重建一个民有、民治、民享的政府，而不是像我们现在这样，是一个

sentences.en: of by and for the billionaires.
sentences.zh: 亿万富翁所有、亿万富翁治理、亿万富翁享有的政府。

sentences.en: Those are ambitious and those seem like long-term programs of political reform.
sentences.zh: 这些目标很宏大，看起来像是长期的政治改革计划。

sentences.en: I'm curious what your approach is to something very specific and real and short-term gas prices.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你对一些非常具体、现实且短期的议题有什么对策，比如汽油价格。

sentences.en: How are you going to lower gas prices?
sentences.zh: 你打算如何降低汽油价格？

sentences.en: Well, I've already laid out a plan to suspend the federal gas tax and the federal diesel tax, which would immediately drop the price of gas by 18 cents a gallon for Texans.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我已经制定了一项计划，旨在暂停联邦汽油税和柴油税，这将使德克萨斯州的汽油价格每加仑立即下降18美分。

sentences.en: And it would save those who use diesel about $200 a year.
sentences.zh: 对于使用柴油的人来说，这每年能节省约200美元。

sentences.en: Now, that's a stopgap measure.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是权宜之计。

sentences.en: The only thing that's going to really lower these prices is ending this disastrous war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 真正能降低这些价格的唯一办法，是结束这场在伊朗的灾难性战争。

sentences.en: And so I think we got to end this military disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们必须结束这场军事灾难。

sentences.en: What would you do to end this war?
sentences.zh: 你会采取什么行动来结束这场战争？

sentences.en: I mean, and do you think current senators have done enough?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你认为现任参议员们做得够多了吗？

sentences.en: No, I mean, I think we need checks and balances back in our government.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我认为我们需要在政府中恢复制衡机制。

sentences.en: I think the legislative branch has to reassert its authority here.
sentences.zh: 我认为立法部门必须在此重申其权威。

sentences.en: I mean, Congress in our constitution is the one that can and should declare war.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，根据我们的宪法，国会才是能够且应该宣战的机构。

sentences.en: And so the War Powers Act, I mean, there are levers that are at our disposal to rein in these overreaches by the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 所以《战争权力法案》，我是说，我们有可用的手段来遏制行政部门的越权行为。

sentences.en: And this war in Iran is a perfect example of that.
sentences.zh: 而这场伊朗战争就是一个完美的例子。

sentences.en: So I think what we desperately need is to restore those checks and balances and check the overreaches of the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们迫切需要的是恢复这些制衡，并遏制行政部门的越权。

sentences.en: I'm curious if I can go back to economic policy, how your agenda is landing in a state where
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，如果回到经济政策的话题，你的议程在一个怎样的州会受到欢迎？

sentences.en: low taxes, limited government, pro-business policies have been the tradition and they've been fairly popular.
sentences.zh: 那里低税收、有限政府和亲商政策一直以来都是传统，而且相当受欢迎。

sentences.en: Among the things you have campaigned on are raising the minimum wage, adopting universal child care, canceling medical debt, higher taxes on billionaires.
sentences.zh: 你竞选的主张包括提高最低工资、推行全民托儿服务、取消医疗债务、提高亿万富翁的税收。

sentences.en: That would seem potentially like a riskier element of a platform that seeks to appeal to a state of such moderation.
sentences.zh: 对于一个寻求吸引如此温和派州的竞选纲领来说，这似乎是一个潜在的风险因素。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, if you're still stuck in a left versus right framework, then moderation makes sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，如果你还困在左派对右派的框架里，那么温和派确实有道理。

sentences.en: But I think when you're thinking in a vertical framework, it's easy to understand how so many working people, so many farmers and ranchers, so many small business owners are just
sentences.zh: 但我认为，当你从纵向框架思考时，就很容易理解为什么那么多劳动者、那么多农民和牧场主、那么多小企业主会感到……

sentences.en: fed up with a rigged system that only benefits the wealthiest people and the biggest corporations in the world.
sentences.zh: 受够了一个只让世界上最富有的人和最大的公司受益的操纵系统。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people in Texas think that is pretty common sense.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为德克萨斯州的很多人认为这非常符合常识。

sentences.en: That's not extreme.
sentences.zh: 这并不极端。

sentences.en: That is middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 这是中庸之道。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I think what I'm advocating for is something that can help unrig this system that has been hurting so many of us across the state, across the country.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为我所倡导的是一种能够帮助打破这个系统的东西，这个系统一直在伤害我们州乃至全国的许多人。

sentences.en: And I will say the systemic reforms I talked about earlier, you described them as long-term.
sentences.zh: 我想说，你之前描述我谈到的系统性改革是长期的。

sentences.en: I think if we abolish the filibuster, those reforms don't have to be long-term.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果我们废除阻挠议事程序，这些改革就不必是长期的。

sentences.en: And you do wish to abolish the filibuster?
sentences.zh: 你确实希望废除阻挠议事程序？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think the majority should be able to govern in this country.
sentences.zh: 我认为多数派应该有能力在这个国家进行治理。

sentences.en: The filibuster is not in our constitution.
sentences.zh: 阻挠议事程序并不在我们的宪法中。

sentences.en: It's a Jim Crow relic.
sentences.zh: 它是吉姆·克劳法时代的遗物。

sentences.en: And it has prevented us from making necessary progress in this country.
sentences.zh: 它阻碍了我们在国内取得必要的进步。

sentences.en: Just to explain, you want the Senate to be able to legislate through 51 votes, majority of the body,
sentences.zh: 简单解释一下，你希望参议院能够通过51票（即机构多数票）来立法，

sentences.en: not 60, not be blocked by filibuster, which the other side would tell you, the Republican side, they have not done because they fear what Democrats would do with it.
sentences.zh: 而不是60票，不被阻挠议事所阻挡。对方，也就是共和党人会告诉你，他们之所以没这么做，是因为担心民主党人会利用它。

sentences.en: But you're saying you're not worried what Republicans might turn around and do with it if it changes.
sentences.zh: 但你是在说，你不担心如果改变了规则，共和党人可能会反过来利用它吗？

sentences.en: I believe the majority should be able to govern.
sentences.zh: 我相信多数派应该有能力治理国家。

sentences.en: I think voters deserve to see the results of their vote, whether I agree with it or not.
sentences.zh: 我认为选民理应看到他们投票的结果，无论我是否同意。

sentences.en: I mean, what's happening right now is because of the filibuster and then because of the systemic corruption, we are, we have gridlock.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在发生的情况是因为阻挠议事程序，再加上系统性的腐败，我们陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And nothing is changing.
sentences.zh: 而且什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: And so the people of this country are, are swinging wildly between the two parties because nothing happens no matter who they elect.
sentences.zh: 所以这个国家的人民在两个政党之间剧烈摇摆，因为无论他们选谁，什么都不会发生。

sentences.en: And I will just say, if the choice for a lot of people in Texas, if the choice is status quo and a demagogue, they're going to choose a demagogue.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，如果德克萨斯州的很多人面临的选择是现状和煽动者，他们会选择煽动者。

sentences.en: They're going to choose what's going to maybe bring some change.
sentences.zh: 他们会选择可能带来一些改变的东西。

sentences.en: And, and I'd rather create a system where we can actually deliver that change without, you know, emboldening demagogues in our politics.
sentences.zh: 而我宁愿建立一个我们能够真正实现这种改变的系统，而不必在我们的政治中助长煽动者。

sentences.en: And I think the filibuster is the primary obstacle, uh, to being able to deliver that progress.
sentences.zh: 我认为阻挠议事程序是实现这一进步的主要障碍。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You're asking a lot of Republicans to vote for you.
sentences.zh: 你正在要求许多共和党人投票给你。

sentences.en: And so I am curious, have you voted for a Republican?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你投过共和党人的票吗？

sentences.en: Most likely in, in the nonpartisan races for school board and city council, I have certainly voted for
sentences.zh: 很可能在校董会和市议会的无党派竞选中，我确实投过

sentences.en: Republicans.
sentences.zh: 共和党人。

sentences.en: But for Congress, for Senate?
sentences.zh: 但在国会、参议院的选举中呢？

sentences.en: No, uh, I don't think I've voted for a Republican in a partisan race, uh, in Texas.
sentences.zh: 不，我不认为我在德克萨斯州的党派竞选中投过共和党人的票。

sentences.en: Uh, and that's because in, you know, in my lifetime, at least since I've been old enough to vote, we have really seen, uh, extremism grip the Republican party in our state.
sentences.zh: 那是因为，你知道，在我有生之年，至少在我达到投票年龄以来，我们确实看到极端主义控制了我们州的共和党。

sentences.en: You know, the days of George W.
sentences.zh: 你知道，乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush or George H.
sentences.zh: 布什或乔治·H·

sentences.en: W.
sentences.zh: W·

sentences.en: Bush were gone by the time I was voting in our state.
sentences.zh: 布什的时代，在我开始投票时就已经过去了。

sentences.en: And that's, I think, uh, exactly why so many conservatives, small C conservatives are joining this movement of ours.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是为什么这么多保守派，即小写的“c”保守派，正在加入我们这场运动的原因。

sentences.en: Uh, we've been endorsed by 20, I think it's actually more than 20 now current and former
sentences.zh: 我们已经得到了20位，我想实际上现在超过20位现任和前任

sentences.en: Republican officials across the state, uh, because they see that one party rule always leads to extremism and corruption.
sentences.zh: 共和党官员的支持，因为他们看到一党专政总是会导致极端主义和腐败。

sentences.en: And that's certainly happened in Texas with Republican one party rule.
sentences.zh: 这在德克萨斯州的共和党一党专政下确实发生了。

sentences.en: But I, I also, I think it, it probably happens.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这可能也会发生。

sentences.en: I've never lived in a one party blue state, but I think you can see in one party blue states, a lack of delivering for working people, a lack of responsiveness.
sentences.zh: 我从未在蓝色州的一党专政下生活过，但我认为你可以看到在蓝色州，缺乏为劳动人民提供服务，缺乏响应能力。

sentences.en: So I think that one party rule in Texas over, over three decades since I was in kindergarten has really led to an extremism and a corruption that I've, I voted against and worked
sentences.zh: 所以我认为德克萨斯州三十多年来，从我上幼儿园起的一党专政，确实导致了一种极端主义和腐败，我一直在投票反对并致力于

sentences.en: against my entire time in public service.
sentences.zh: 反对它，贯穿我整个公共服务生涯。

sentences.en: I wonder how much when we talk about your appeal in this race to Republicans, you think your character and biography is at the core of that appeal.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，当我们谈论你在这次竞选中对共和党人的吸引力时，你认为你的性格和个人经历在其中占了多大比重。

sentences.en: When I think about your success in this race, especially with Republicans, I think about your fluency with
sentences.zh: 当我想到你在这次竞选中的成功，特别是与共和党人的互动时，我想到你对

sentences.en: religion, specifically with Christianity and the prominence it plays in your campaign.
sentences.zh: 宗教的熟稔，特别是基督教，以及它在你的竞选中所扮演的重要角色。

sentences.en: It feels like over the past 15 to 20 years, Republicans have laid claim to Christianity.
sentences.zh: 感觉在过去15到20年里，共和党人已经宣称拥有了基督教。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一个

sentences.en: Christian right.
sentences.zh: 基督教右派。

sentences.en: There's not really a Christian left.
sentences.zh: 并没有真正的基督教左派。

sentences.en: Do you think Democrats have been too reluctant to do what you're doing, which is to appeal to voters on faith-based grounds?
sentences.zh: 你认为民主党人是否太不情愿做你正在做的事情，即以信仰为基础来吸引选民？

sentences.en: I mean, I think candidates in both parties should show up as they are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为两党的候选人都应该展现真实的自我。

sentences.en: They should be themselves and they should share their why.
sentences.zh: 他们应该做他们自己，并分享他们的初衷。

sentences.en: And if that's faith, like it is for me, then candidates should talk about it.
sentences.zh: 如果那是信仰，就像对我而言一样，那么候选人就应该谈论它。

sentences.en: From what I can sense is that a lot of Democrats have felt uncomfortable talking about faith.
sentences.zh: 据我所感，许多民主党人对谈论信仰感到不自在。

sentences.en: And I think the mistake that people in my party have made is that they, they confuse the separation of church and state with a separation of faith and politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为我所在政党的人所犯的错误是，他们将政教分离与信仰和政治的分离混为一谈了。

sentences.en: We want people to bring their faiths, their moralities, their ethics, their worldview, their philosophies to our politics.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们将他们的信仰、道德、伦理、世界观和哲学带入我们的政治中。

sentences.en: We want a politics that is spiritually rooted, rooted in something deeper than partisanship, than red team versus blue team.
sentences.zh: 我们想要一种植根于精神的政治，植根于比党派之争、比红队对蓝队更深层的东西。

sentences.en: We want our politics to be rooted in timeless values.
sentences.zh: 我们希望我们的政治植根于永恒的价值观。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying it has to be sectarian Christianity.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这必须是宗派性的基督教。

sentences.en: I hope it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 我希望它不仅限于此。

sentences.en: I hope it's people from all different traditions coming together to have a rich conversation about how our politics should reflect our shared values.
sentences.zh: 我希望来自不同传统的人们能够聚在一起，就我们的政治应如何反映我们共同的价值观进行丰富的对话。

sentences.en: That's the distinction I think we have to remember.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们必须记住的区别。

sentences.en: The separation of church and state should never be mistaken for a separation of faith and politics.
sentences.zh: 政教分离绝不应被误认为是信仰与政治的分离。

sentences.en: Jimmy Carter, Dr. King, Dorothy Day,
sentences.zh: 吉米·卡特、马丁·路德·金博士、多萝西·戴、

sentences.en: Mr. Rogers, all these people brought their faith to their service.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯先生，所有这些人都在服务中带来了他们的信仰。

sentences.en: And I think that we need more of that in this country, not less of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要在这个国家看到更多这样的表现，而不是更少。

sentences.en: Do you think that if you win this race, it will, speaking of faith, speaking of character,
sentences.zh: 你认为如果你赢得了这场竞选，说到信仰，说到品格，

sentences.en: it will have been because of the contrast with your opponent, Ken Paxton, on the question of character, on the question of morality?
sentences.zh: 那是因为与你的对手肯·帕克斯顿在品格问题、道德问题上的对比吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think it will be because of the contrast in terms of policy?
sentences.zh: 还是你认为是因为政策上的对比？

sentences.en: I'm not sure what the difference is between those two things.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这两者之间有什么区别。

sentences.en: You know, I think our policies are a reflection of our morality.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我们的政策是我们道德的反映。

sentences.en: And I think the corruption that I talk about in this campaign is deeper than just illegal corruption.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我在这次竞选中谈到的腐败比单纯的非法腐败更深层。

sentences.en: I'm also talking about a deeper corruption.
sentences.zh: 我谈论的也是一种更深层的腐败。

sentences.en: I mean, the rotting of something from within.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，某种东西从内部腐烂。

sentences.en: And we've seen that in every part of American life, in our politics, our government, in our churches.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国生活的方方面面都看到了这一点，在我们的政治、政府、教堂里。

sentences.en: We've seen it in business, in our economy.
sentences.zh: 我们在商业、经济中也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: There is something deeply broken in this country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家有什么东西彻底坏掉了。

sentences.en: And I hope that our little campaign in Texas can be a part of a much larger movement toward spiritual renewal and fighting that corruption at its root.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们在德克萨斯州的小小竞选能成为一场更大规模运动的一部分，朝着精神更新和从根源上打击腐败的方向努力。

sentences.en: So yes, I hope this campaign in our state is a part of something much bigger.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我希望我们在本州的这场竞选是更宏大事业的一部分。

sentences.en: On the subject of what it would look like if you become a Democratic senator from Texas, and if
sentences.zh: 关于如果你成为来自德克萨斯州的民主党参议员会是什么样子，以及如果

sentences.en: Democrats do win the Senate back, you'll become part of a system that you've characterized multiple times in this conversation as broken.
sentences.zh: 民主党人确实赢回了参议院，你将成为一个你在这次谈话中多次形容为“坏掉的”系统的一部分。

sentences.en: And so I want to ask you how you're going to navigate that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想问你将如何应对这一点。

sentences.en: Let's say Democrats have a slim majority.
sentences.zh: 假设民主党人拥有微弱的多数席位。

sentences.en: That seems like the likely scenario if they were to flip the Senate.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能翻转参议院，这似乎是可能的情况。

sentences.en: And I imagine you'll suddenly be in the middle of fierce debates among Democrats over what the Democratic majority should be focused on.
sentences.zh: 我想你很快就会陷入民主党内部关于民主党多数派应该关注什么的激烈辩论中。

sentences.en: And I do want to understand what you think that mandate will be.
sentences.zh: 我确实想了解你认为那个授权会是什么。

sentences.en: If your colleagues in the Democratic Party want to suddenly impeach the president or a member of the cabinet, is that what you think your mandate is?
sentences.zh: 如果你的民主党同事突然想要弹劾总统或内阁成员，你认为你的授权就是那样吗？

sentences.en: Is there someone in the cabinet you want to see impeached?
sentences.zh: 内阁里有你想看到被弹劾的人吗？

sentences.en: Or is that not at all what you want this to be about?
sentences.zh: 还是说你根本不希望这成为重点？

sentences.en: Well, my mandate, if we're successful in this race, will be to take on corruption and lower costs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我们在这次竞选中成功，我的授权将是打击腐败和降低成本。

sentences.en: Those are the two things we've been talking about every day on the campaign trail, the two things that we have heard from voters across this state.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在竞选过程中每天都在谈论的两件事，也是我们从全州选民那里听到的两件事。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I want us in the United States
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我希望我们在美国

sentences.en: Senate, hopefully on a bipartisan basis, not just Democrats, to do those two things.
sentences.zh: 参议院，希望是在两党合作的基础上，不仅仅是民主党人，来做这两件事。

sentences.en: We should tackle the corruption in our system, whether we see it in the executive branch, in the legislative branch, in the judicial branch.
sentences.zh: 我们应该解决我们系统中的腐败问题，无论是在行政部门、立法部门还是司法部门看到的腐败。

sentences.en: And then we should, after we're able to clean up that corruption, start delivering for working people.
sentences.zh: 然后，在我们能够清理掉这些腐败之后，我们应该开始为劳动人民带来成果。

sentences.en: When we unrig this economy, when we unrig this political system, that will allow us to actually get this economy back on track so that people who work hard can get ahead.
sentences.zh: 当我们打破这个经济系统，打破这个政治系统时，这将使我们能够真正让经济回到正轨，让努力工作的人能够出人头地。

sentences.en: That might sound to some people like impeach and then legislate.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，这听起来可能像是先弹劾再立法。

sentences.en: Well, again, as a state lawmaker, I sat in an impeachment hearing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，再说一次，作为州议员，我参加过弹劾听证会。

sentences.en: It's ironically against the person that I'm running againSt. Yes.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，针对的是我正在竞选反对的人。是的。

sentences.en: And I characterized it at the time.
sentences.zh: 我当时就对此进行了定性。

sentences.en: This was long before the Senate race against Ken Paxton.
sentences.zh: 那是在针对肯·帕克斯顿的参议院竞选很久之前。

sentences.en: I characterized it as the most important vote that I was going to cast as a lawmaker because we were voting to remove a duly elected public
sentences.zh: 我将其定性为我作为议员将投下的最重要的票，因为我们是在投票罢免一位正式当选的公职

sentences.en: official from office, which is a major thing to consider.
sentences.zh: 人员，这是一件需要慎重考虑的大事。

sentences.en: And I carefully evaluated the evidence in that trial.
sentences.zh: 我仔细评估了那次审判中的证据。

sentences.en: I read every document line by line.
sentences.zh: 我逐行阅读了每一份文件。

sentences.en: And I joined with Republicans on the other side of the aisle who saw the same thing I saw.
sentences.zh: 我与对面的共和党人站在一起，他们看到了和我一样的东西。

sentences.en: And we came to the same conclusion that this man is unfit for public office.
sentences.zh: 我们得出了同样的结论，即此人不适合担任公职。

sentences.en: And I did my duty in that impeachment vote.
sentences.zh: 我在那次弹劾投票中履行了我的职责。

sentences.en: And if an impeachment vote comes up in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果美国参议院出现弹劾投票，如果我参与了弹劾审判，我会仔细评估证据，并据此投票。

sentences.en: Senate, if I'm a part of an impeachment trial, I will carefully evaluate the evidence and I will vote accordingly.
sentences.zh: 但我当然不会在播客上预判弹劾审判。

sentences.en: But I'm certainly not going to not going to prejudge an impeachment trial on a podcaSt. Understood.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But do you think President Trump is central to the corruption problem you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 但你认为特朗普总统是你所谈论的腐败问题的核心吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I certainly think that we've seen unprecedented corruption in this administration.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我当然认为我们在这届政府中看到了前所未有的腐败。

sentences.en: And I think it angers people in both political parties, including some of the president's strongest supporters.
sentences.zh: 我认为这激怒了两个政党的人，包括总统的一些最坚定的支持者。

sentences.en: Again, people in Texas, including people in my family, voted for President Trump in 2024 because they thought he was going to lower costs.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，德克萨斯州的人，包括我家人在内，在2024年投票给特朗普总统，因为他们认为他会降低成本。

sentences.en: They thought he was going to drain the swamp.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他会清理沼泽。

sentences.en: They thought he was going to end the wars.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他会结束战争。

sentences.en: They thought he was going to release the Epstein files.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他会公布爱泼斯坦文件。

sentences.en: But more than a year into this administration, everything is more expensive because of these corrupt tariffs.
sentences.zh: 但在本届政府执政一年多后，由于这些腐败的关税，一切都变得更贵了。

sentences.en: The swamp is bigger than it's ever been before because of this corruption that you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 由于你所谈论的这种腐败，沼泽比以往任何时候都更大。

sentences.en: We have a new corrupt war in the Middle East and the Epstein files have still not been fully released.
sentences.zh: 我们在中东有一场新的腐败战争，而爱泼斯坦文件仍未完全公布。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of disillusionment in our state, including among the president's core supporters.
sentences.zh: 所以我们州有很多幻灭感，包括在总统的核心支持者中。

sentences.en: I have a final question for you.
sentences.zh: 我有一个最后一个问题要问你。

sentences.en: I know you have to go to a rally.
sentences.zh: 我知道你得去参加集会了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情正在发生。

sentences.en: Let's say everything I've just been describing in these scenarios doesn't come to pass.
sentences.zh: 假设我刚才描述的这些情景都没有发生。

sentences.en: You do not win in November.
sentences.zh: 你在十一月没有胜选。

sentences.en: And Senator-elect Paxton, despite all the scandals that have trailed him, goes to Washington.
sentences.zh: 而当选参议员帕克斯顿，尽管他身上背负着各种丑闻，还是去了华盛顿。

sentences.en: Texas stays red.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州依然是共和党的天下。

sentences.en: Democrats don't take the Senate.
sentences.zh: 民主党没有拿下参议院。

sentences.en: What will it say to you that Democrats couldn't win in this political environment when the president is this unpopular?
sentences.zh: 在总统如此不受欢迎的政治环境下，民主党却无法获胜，这对你来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: And what would it say that you couldn't win Texas?
sentences.zh: 而且，无法拿下德克萨斯州又说明了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it'll mean that we have a lot more work to do in Texas and the work will continue long after this campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这意味着我们在德克萨斯州还有很多工作要做，而且这项工作在竞选结束后仍将持续很久。

sentences.en: Whether we're successful or not, we are part of a relay race of Texans who have been fighting for the promise of this state.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否成功，我们都是德克萨斯州接力赛的一员，为了这个州的未来而奋斗。

sentences.en: And even if we're not successful in this election, that work will continue.
sentences.zh: 即使我们在这次选举中没有成功，这项工作也会继续下去。

sentences.en: And hopefully we'll learn lessons from this campaign, lessons on what to do and maybe lessons on what not to do.
sentences.zh: 希望我们能从这次竞选中吸取教训，总结出哪些该做，哪些或许不该做。

sentences.en: And I'll be proud to have played that role in this much longer and larger movement.
sentences.zh: 我为能在这场更漫长、更宏大的运动中发挥作用而感到自豪。

sentences.en: Will it have meant, though, that money ultimately conquered the momentum that we are seeing the Democrats have in these red states?
sentences.zh: 但这是否意味着，金钱最终战胜了我们所看到的民主党在这些红州所拥有的势头？

sentences.en: Big money is powerful, and I'm not going to sugarcoat it.
sentences.zh: 大资本的力量很强大，我不会粉饰这一点。

sentences.en: But my faith teaches me that it is nothing compared to people power.
sentences.zh: 但我的信仰告诉我，与人民的力量相比，它微不足道。

sentences.en: And when we put our faith in our neighbors and our collective ability to make change, that will one day pay off.
sentences.zh: 当我们把信念寄托在邻里身上，并相信我们集体改变现状的能力时，终有一天会得到回报。

sentences.en: It may not happen tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 这可能不会在明天发生。

sentences.en: It may not happen on November 3rd.
sentences.zh: 可能不会在十一月三日发生。

sentences.en: It may not happen in our lifetimes.
sentences.zh: 可能在我们有生之年都不会发生。

sentences.en: But faith means living a larger story.
sentences.zh: 但信仰意味着活出更宏大的篇章。

sentences.en: And so we're going to keep running that relay race, and we'll pass it off to the folks who come after us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将继续跑这场接力赛，并把它传给后来者。

sentences.en: And one day we will win.
sentences.zh: 终有一天我们会赢。

sentences.en: Well, Representative Tallarico, thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，塔拉里科众议员，感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Appreciate it very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Good luck with your rally.
sentences.zh: 祝你的集会顺利。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
